lines.zh: 我走路时，别人会主动让开。
lines.en: When I walk, others step aside.

lines.zh: 这身长衫太碍事，我提着下摆。
lines.en: My robe drags; I lift the hem.

lines.zh: 每一步都不出声，这是刺客的习惯。
lines.en: Each step is silent — an assassin's habit.

lines.zh: 我来去都靠柱子，可惜现在没有。
lines.en: I travel by pillar — if only one were here.
I check the money in my pocket.

lines.zh: 目标不远了，我得收着气。
lines.en: The target is near; I keep my ki hidden.
Light steps, heavy hands.

lines.zh: 我从城镇穿过去，不看任何人。
lines.en: I cut through the town, eyes forward.
These shoes are expensive. Do not scuff them.

lines.zh: 我走着，顺便数有几户人家。
lines.en: I walk and count households along the way.

lines.zh: 路太烂了，我的裤子沾了泥。
lines.en: Mud on my trousers. Disgraceful.

lines.zh: 我在盘算这次能赚多少钱。
lines.en: I am calculating the fee.

lines.zh: 我站着也很少有人敢靠近。
lines.en: Even standing, few dare approach.
I adjust my cuffs.
No decent liquor here.

lines.zh: 我掐着指头算了算时辰。
lines.en: I count the hours on my fingers.
No payment, no work.
Have you heard my name?
I smooth my hair back.

lines.zh: 冷风一吹，长衫就贴在腿上。
lines.en: The cold wind plasters my robe to my legs.

lines.zh: 我抬头看鸟，鸟就飞走了。
lines.en: I look at a bird; it flies off.

lines.zh: 我讨厌脏活，但钱是好东西。
lines.en: I loathe dirty work — but money is money.
I brush dust off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这附近没有像样的对手。
lines.en: No worthy opponent nearby.

lines.zh: 活要挑着做，钱要挑多的拿。
lines.en: Pick the job, take the fattest fee.
I squint at distant smoke.
Why stare? Looking to hire me?
You do not carry much money.
I do not work on credit.
Your ki is muddled. Untrained.

lines.zh: 站远一点，我不喜欢别人的汗味。
lines.en: Back off. I dislike the smell of sweat.

lines.zh: 你听说过红缎带军团吗？
lines.en: Have you heard of the Red Ribbon Army?

lines.zh: 我杀人不看脸，只看价钱。
lines.en: I do not look at faces, only prices.
Care to try my tongue?
Your eyes are not cruel enough.
I smile. That kind of smile.
If you want to walk away, do not ask.

lines.zh: 这双手，杀过比你强的人。
lines.en: These hands have killed better than you.
Your soles are worn through.
Three breaths of staring is enough.
I hear a coin pouch on you.
I raise a hand for you to stop talking.
What is your life worth?

lines.zh: 这伤会留疤，可惜了这身皮。
lines.en: A scar, and I had nice skin.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，掸了掸衣服。
lines.en: I step back and brush my clothes.
I grit my teeth and smile.
This will not slow my strike.

lines.zh: 我按住伤口，血渗过指缝。
lines.en: I press the wound; blood seeps between my fingers.
I wipe the blood on the grass.
A torn shirt bothers me more than the wound.
Still standing. The fee stands.
Payment first, then we talk.
Not enough to move my hands.
Liquor? Then I will sit.
I smell roast meat.

lines.zh: 这可以当你预付的定金。
lines.en: Consider this a down payment.
I eat slowly, properly.

lines.zh: 你不怕我在饭里下东西？
lines.en: You are not afraid I might have doctored it?
Bring another plate.
I will consider the job after eating.
I wipe my mouth, satisfied.
Do not touch my clothes.
You do not know who I am?
I raise an elbow and hold you off.
One more touch and it costs you.
Your shoulder is too coarse.
I sidestep easily.
That is all the skill you have?
Do not smear mud on me.
I dislike being touched.
Let us each give a step.
I love only money.
A tedious subject.
In my trade, we do not.
You do not qualify.
I shake my head and straighten my sleeve.
When I retire, perhaps.
I want no attachments.
That is not on my price list.
I turn my face away.
Save your breath.
Money on the ground is still money.
I bend down, carefully.
This ring is worth something.
I check it for markings first.
I tuck it into an inner pocket.
Unclaimed, so mine.

lines.zh: 这布料不错，可以做件衫。
lines.en: Good cloth — it could make a shirt.

lines.zh: 我嫌它脏，用两个指头捏。
lines.en: I pinch it between two fingers, disgusted.
Stow it. Do not show wealth.
This trip was not wasted.

lines.zh: 我认定你了，价钱也谈好了。
lines.en: You are the target, and the price is settled.
Halt. I dislike chasing.
My tongue is faster than a blade.
Do not fear. It will be quick.
Someone is paying for your life.
My sleeve flicks; my finger points at you.
This is business. Do not blame me.
You are on my list.
My eyes have changed.
One breath is enough.
Choose how you want to stand.
I set my weight on my back foot.
No fee this time. Your luck.
At three, your chance is gone.
One finger is enough for a Dodon Ray.
Do not go. The price is negotiable.
Your left foot barely takes weight.
My hand has not moved.
You retreat fast. That is fear.
The Dodon Ray needs a moment.
I wait for you to open up.

lines.zh: 我的衬衫不能被血弄脏。
lines.en: I must keep blood off my shirt.
The tenser you are, the sloppier you get.
I am working out the angle.
Your armor stops at the waist.
I raise my hand; you step back.

lines.zh: 洞洞波从我舌尖射出去。
lines.en: The dodon ray fires from my tongue.
Standing right there. Good.
A clean kick.
I chop at your neck.
A third of my strength.
Your guard is half an inch off.
I tap your knee with my toe.
The Dodon Ray fires from my fingertip.
My kick drives you back three steps.

lines.zh: 我从柱子上跳下，没有声音。
lines.en: I drop from the pillar without a sound.
That one is free of charge.
I catch your blade on my forearm.
I pivot and drive my palm heel into your ribs.
You were hit before you saw it.
Two kicks in a row.
I knock you askew and keep going.
That stained my cuff.
I recover cleanly.
Whoever paid, speak.
This place looks cheap.

lines.zh: 我落下来，尘土都没惊动。
lines.en: I land without disturbing the dust.
I straighten my collar.
I dislike long journeys.
Someone mentioned my name?
I take this job.

lines.zh: 你们人不少，可惜不顶用。
lines.en: Numbers, but no use.
I pull my hat low.
Dirt on my clothes. Annoying.
Down payment first.

lines.zh: 我来杀一个人，不是来打架。
lines.en: I come to kill one, not to brawl.

lines.zh: 我看了看四周，没什么值得拿的。
lines.en: I look around. Nothing worth taking.
Whoever speaks first dies first.
I am here. You may disperse.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的衣角，我拍灭了。
lines.en: Fire catches my hem; I beat it out.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，屈膝卸力。
lines.en: I drop from height and fold my knees.

lines.zh: 水进了鼻子，我要窒息了。
lines.en: Water floods my nose. I am drowning.
The blast flips my clothes up.
A needle pricks my arm.
Magic scatters my ki.
Hungry, and my aim suffers.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，头发都竖了。
lines.en: Lightning hits; my hair stands on end.

lines.zh: 脚下什么也没有，连气都提不起来。
lines.en: Nothing beneath me. I cannot raise my ki.
